paragraphs.text: Malpiri was the name of a nation of Terisiare on Dominaria during the Brothers' War and the Dark Age .
Its heartlands were the Malpiri Plains , located northeast of the Monastery of Gix .

The Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invited Kathwar , chief of the Malpiri clan, representing the Sardian people as well as the Malpiri, to join the Council of Mages . Kathwar was the representative of shamanic mountain magic on the Council.
In the northern part of the Malipiri plains lay a cluster of mountains known as the Flarg , which was home to an aggressive tribe of goblins .

Like most nations of Terisiare , Malpiri was devastated during the Brothers' War . The Malpiri people remained on the cooling plains through the Dark Age , eventually becoming supplanted by the newly formed nation of Balduvia during the Ice Age .
